study: Frozen classifiers on author TCMEval-SDT test partition
partition: 50 Test_TCM_Data_v1.json records with Results/Test_data_result.txt expert answers
training: None. Both checkpoints and preprocessing are fixed from previous experiments; no adaptation or model selection on this partition.
input: Clinical Data first 4096 characters; frozen v2 vectorizer
gold: Parse expert semicolon-separated choice letters, map exactly to the record's Options of TCM Syndrome; strip whitespace and one trailing Chinese character 证, as v3 did.
prediction: Unrestricted ranking over the model's 148 labels, stable ties. Do not restrict to supplied multiple-choice options.
metrics: Top1 and top3 any-gold hit, known-label coverage ceiling, conditional hit among records containing known gold, per-case correctness and paired comparison; not single-label diagnosis accuracy or paper cohort replication.
overlap: Audit normalized exact input text against TCM-SD train/dev; report all and previously unseen subsets. This does not rule out paraphrase overlap or foundation-model pretraining contamination.
prior_access: Dataset answer formatting was inspected before protocol; no classifier predictions on this partition were inspected. Original 200 TCMEval training cases are reused development, not this test partition.
